messages.subject: Error in g.part1
parts:
Hi Vincent et all,

I've just arrived to your package  and I'm trying to process a two day .bin file from a GeneActiv device.
While executing g.part1 while "getting meta data" this error occurs:
    Error in butter.default(n = 5, Wc, type = c("pass")) : 
    butter: critical frequencies must be in (0 1)
  
Before trying with g.part1 I've done without problems the "long way":
I=(g.inspectfile(datafile) -> C=g.calibrate(datafile) -> M=g.getmeta(datafile) -> g.impute(M, I) -> g.analyse(I, C, M, IMP) -> g.plot(IMP, M, I, durplot = 4)
  
Do you have any idea of the reason of it?
Thanks in advance

Iñigo Zunzunegui

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in g.part1
parts:
Hi Inigo,
Sharing the exact call to function g.part1 would help me to assess your problem.
- Did you specify hb and lb as input arguments?
- What is your sampling rate?
The default value for hb is 15 Hz, which is too high if your data is
collected at 30 Hz, so you would have to explicitly set the hb
argument to 14 Hz or lower.
Best wishes,
Vincent
